The test image shows a corn leaf with light green to yellow streaks/stripes running lengthwise along the veins — a mosaic/mottle pattern with no discrete spots or pustules. This points to a viral disease: candidates are Maize_Dwarf_Mosaic_Virus, Maize_Streak_Virus, or Maize_Chlorotic_Dwarf_Virus.

Reading one reference image for Maize_Dwarf_Mosaic_Virus:

The reference MDMV image shows light/dark mottling on the leaf. The test image has more pronounced yellow-to-pale streaks running lengthwise along the veins — this mosaic streaking pattern matches the MDMV description well ("narrow, light green to yellow streaks along leaf veins; mosaic pattern"). The reference confirms the general mottled green-yellow appearance on leaf tissue.
